children.name: Location placement

children.name: Changing location help
children.content: Changing location starts a fresh draft. The chosen location handles all creation steps.

vdTcx.content: Used as pod name and subdomain. Lowercase, dash-separated.

usWsj.content: Hardcore survival realm with curated mods. Invite only.

children.name: Helper
children.content: Only the reserved amount counts when the server is placed on a node, so more servers fit; it can use more, up to the limit, when the node has room (Burstable QoS).

children.name: Helper
children.content: Picks node with most free memory, tolerations or no taints.

vdTcx.content: Server description shown in the multiplayer list.
Leave blank for a random seed.

Qx06J.content: Verify players with Mojang. Disable only for offline/LAN setups.

vdTcx.content: Java heap ceiling (-Xmx, e.g. 2G, 3072M). Leave empty to size it automatically to 75% of the container memory limit — it then tracks the limit whenever you resize the server. If you set it yourself, keep roughly 25% below the limit: the JVM needs headroom for non-heap memory, and exceeding the limit gets the server OOM-killed.
Starting heap size (-Xms), at most JVM max heap. Leave empty to match the automatic max heap (a fixed heap avoids GC resizes).

children.name: TipText
children.content: Memory tip — factor in mod/plugin overhead; Minecraft Vanilla uses ~1.5 GB at 4 players.
